labels.quote: A six-pound entry rebate increased the travel fund from eighty-four pounds to ninety.
labels.reason: 84 + 6 = 90; an explicit intervening rebate accounts for the increase.

labels.quote: Ada left her shoes under the table while she checked the exchange mark in socks. The boards were cold enough to sharpen her attention. On the next full-speed trial her shoes struck the track cleanly, and the call reached Nessa at the right moment.
labels.reason: A routine act of putting the shoes back on is reasonably omitted; the text never says she ran in socks.
